Our mobile-first app gives more than 2 million users access to the latest tokens, tokenized stocks, and leverage trading, with over $4B in volume processed since launch in 2024. Every trade, auto-sell, and fee flow runs on-chain, and the contracts behind them have to be fast, safe, and correct.</p> <p><strong>The Role</strong><br>You’ll own the on-chain programs that power Moonshot’s trading products on Solana and EVM chains. You’ll take each contract from spec through audit to production, and help design how we expand to new chains and products. We’re a small team, so you’ll join early and ship real code fast. Expect your first production deployment within your first two weeks.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <p>Own core trading programs, including order execution, auto-sell, fee routing, and token launch, from specification to deployment and audit<br>Design cross-chain and settlement paths alongside our protocol engineers<br>Build and maintain a thorough test suite using Anchor tests, Foundry, and property-based fuzzing<br>Work directly with our security auditors on each release cycle</p> <p><strong>You Might Be a Fit If You</strong></p> <p>Have shipped production programs on Solana (Anchor) or an EVM L2, ideally securing more than $10M in TVL or volume<br>Can debug at the bytecode level when something breaks at 2 a.m.<br>Value the unglamorous work: testing, fuzzing, formal verification, and audits<br>Have delivered at least one end-to-end cross-chain integration (bridges, oracles, or settlement)<br>Understand trading mechanics such as slippage, MEV, and transaction ordering on Solana</p> <p><strong>Compensation &amp; Benefits</strong></p> <p>$150K base salary plus meaningful early-stage equity<br>Full health, dental, and vision coverage (US-based hires)<br>$2,000 annual learning budget</p> <p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/moonshot-solidity-rust-remote">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/moonshot-solidity-rust-remote</a></p> Thu, 22 Oct 2026 13:00:33 +0000 Sat, 21 Nov 2026 13:00:33 +0000 https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/moonshot-solidity-rust-remote https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/moonshot-solidity-rust-remote Affirm: Analytics Engineer II, Full Stack (Revenue Analytics) Anywhere in the World Full-Stack Programming Full-Time <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote Poland </p> <div class="content-intro"><p>At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.</p></div><p>We’re looking for a curious, driven professional to join our Revenue Analytics team. The ideal candidate combines strong technical and analytical skills with the ability to turn ambiguous business questions into durable, well-tested data infrastructure.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li> <p>Develop dbt data models, dashboards, metrics, and automation processes for the revenue field team and revenue analysts</p> </li> <li> <p>Build and maintain critical reporting data models that power external merchant reporting&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Build the semantic, metadata, and context layers that allow AI systems to accurately understand Revenue data, metrics, and business definitions</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with Business Systems, engineering, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into durable, well-tested data products</p> </li> foundations to scale the impact of analytics within Revenue.</p> </li> </ul> <p><br><strong>What we look for</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li> <p>3+ years of work experience in an analytics engineering or (Sigma/Looker/Tableau), Databricks, and cloud data warehouses (Snowflake)</p> </li> <li> <p>Understanding of the data foundations required for reliable AI, including semantic layers, metadata, evals, metric definitions, documentation, and data quality</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrated experience integrating AI tools into day-to-day analytics engineering workflows to improve development speed, communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Total rewards</strong></h3> <div> <p>We believe the people building honest
